CustomField.description: Where the app's "Go Online" screen (embedded browser) navigates to. A relative Salesforce path (e.g. "/lightning/o/Report/home") opens signed in automatically via frontdoor.jsp using the rep's own session -- no separate login. A full external https:// URL opens as a plain, unauthenticated page. Blank defaults to the org's Lightning home page.
CustomField.label: Go Online Destination URL
